settings.fallback_content:

Adjust to Desire

Sleep on it for [adjust_label]. Tell us how it should feel. We send the layer that takes you there, and you keep it, with our compliments.

Every layer we send stays with you. It is not a warranty claim, and it is not a return.

If that still does not settle it

We collect the mattress and refund you in full. Contact us within [return_words] days of delivery.

Emperor

Emperor is made to order at 200 x 200cm and is not covered by the [return_days]-day return trial. Adjust to Desire still applies. Your statutory cancellation rights are unaffected.

Refund timing

Once the mattress is collected and inspected for damage beyond normal trial use, refunds go back to the original payment method within 5-10 business days.
